name: Creamy Chicken Enchiladas with Roasted Sweet Potato & Cauliflower (Two Ways)

ingredients.name: rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Preheat oven to 450°F. Coat a baking dish with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
454 g sweet potato
½ medium head cauliflower
½ jalapeño pepper
¼ small bunch cilantro
½ lime

instructions.primary_message: Peel and large dice sweet potatoes. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.

Separate cauliflower into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add to the baking sheet with the sweet potato, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are golden and fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level, then small dice. Place in a medium bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)

Place chicken on a cutting board and, using your hands, remove meat from the skin and bones. Separate the meat into shred-like pieces. Place a ½-cup of chicken in a small bowl and set aside. Add remaining chicken to the bowl with the jalapeño.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (532 g) whole chicken rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat

instructions.primary_message: Add yogurt and spices to the medium bowl, then stir to combine the filling.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup plain Greek yogurt
¼ tsp cumin, ground
¼ tsp coriander, ground
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place tortillas on a flat surface and divide filling between them. Wrap tortillas around the filling and place, seam-side down, in the baking dish. Top with enchilada sauce and cheese.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (283 g) can red enchilada sauce
½ cup shredded cheese, Mexican blend

instructions.primary_message: Add baking dish to the oven and bake until cheese is melted and filling is warmed through, 10-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, place additional tortillas on a flat surface and divide reserved plain chicken and cheese between them, arranging the filling on one half of each tortilla. Fold quesadillas in half to close.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ cup shredded cheese, Mexican blend

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Place assembled quesadillas in the skillet and cook, flipping halfway through, until cheese is melted and tortillas are golden on both sides, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat and cut into wedges.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Cut lime into wedges.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide 1 cup of roasted veggies and quesadillas between plates. Serve with yogurt for dipping. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide remaining roasted veggies and enchiladas between plates; top veggies with cilantro and a squeeze of lime. Enjoy!
